Makeup and Body are retained candidate workflows, but this frozen workflow cohort has no directly named Makeup- or Body-specific WORKFLOW operation. This is not product-feature absence.

Effect copy/paste, asset favorites, tags or language sync remain in their explicit non-cloud workflow context; no generic sync-to-Cloud inference.
Team membership denotes explicit training, preset, space or sharing limitation context only. It does not confer roles, camera permissions, subscription eligibility or all-platform support.
RAW compatibility/output constraints and Lightroom roundtrips remain separate referenced stages; JPEG/TIFF or catalog branches are not promoted into RAW editing/rendering support.
Different documented watched-folder limits and export intervals are retained in their source records, not silently reconciled by chain normalization.
Printable QR cards and Print sharpening are workflow contexts; no physical printer, output color, media or print-chain test was performed.
